shipReasons: HOLD. R39F-01 is a major regression against live in the changed area (FFX Ch X): the Sensor card covers about 48% of Seymour Natus at the first menu and whenever Mortibody is aimed, at 1600x900, 2000x1012 and 2560x1440; live covers 0%. The cause is measured (hud-floor.css omits --ffx-sensor-py) and the fix is one line; with the term added the cover is 0.0 to 0.1%.

R39F-02 is a second major regression: Evrae (FFX Ch VIII) now cuts between poses, 19.54 snaps a minute against 0.46 on live. It removes the severe double images (9 to 0) at the price of hard cuts; by the written rule a snap the change adds is a regression, and whether a cut beats a ghost is Bailey's call. The HOLD does not depend on it alone.

No critical defect and nothing lost: three real-key fights won through the Victory screen and the board (Ch I 73 turns, Ch IV 48, Ch VIII 76; the cleared tile survived a reload), a Ch I defeat reached the Defeat screen and Retry reached a new battle, Ch V and XIII ran, Lady Luck's reels played by key, pad and tap in Wait and Active; 0 console errors, 0 missing files and 0 bad art responses in 125 recorded runs (5,510 art responses; the 19 redirects are all live release 38's raw @ URLs).

The release's other claims held: F plus by default and the governor only stepping down (F plus, F, A2, then staying); the phone keeps its chain; 2x, 3x and 4x masters load and decode in Chromium and WebKit (2,918 of 2,918); the six un-held backdrops draw 2x masters (link permitting, R39F-07); Chapter III calm menus and the target-aware lunge; the twirl start, dressphere shot, run-in truck and Bevelle conduits; Defend by Q, click, tap and pad with Shift not defending; the slab on pad Select; Bushido and Swordplay by tap and click; TEXT SIZE 115 and 130; EYE CANDY; the first-run guide; the corrected Seymour Flux text; Lady Luck's availability.

This release discloses R39F-03 and R39F-04: CHK-026 and CHK-027 still FAIL on the candidate as they do on live, with fewer feet and registered-head failures (868 to 137, 57.1% to 8.4%), fewer jerks (230 to 146) and double images (20 to 15). Fix R39F-01 and the build is better than live on every other measured point; R39F-02 needs Bailey's answer.
